project.name: osgi/runtime/junit-launcher
project.description: The jGiven-FREE JUnit-Platform runner, run inside Felix: JUnitLauncherCore (a Launcher on a dedicated host-bound thread, the three OSGi crossings handled) + its injected strategies (DiscoveryStrategy, HarvestStrategy) + the in-container test envelope (InContainerJUnitRunner, the *Test enumeration → PASS/FAIL lines). Extracted from scenario-engine so a RUNNER-ONLY world (a *ContractInContainerTest / *EdgeBootTest that runs plain JUnit in-container via withJUnitRunner) installs THIS bundle — which imports only the JUnit platform + boot-discovery — instead of scenario-engine, whose exported package genuinely needs jGiven (SeedScenario → com.tngtech.jgiven.junit5). Keeping the runner here means neither bundle lies about its imports: this one is jGiven-free, scenario-engine's jGiven imports are honest/mandatory. A scenario is played by scenario-engine's ScenarioPlayer THROUGH this core (scenario-engine depends on it), with jgiven-wrap staged in that world.
